quotes.speaker: Cris
quotes.text: It was quite some time ago. I was having lunch with my father. I saw this pretty girl sitting at the bar all by herself.

quotes.speaker: Cris
quotes.text: I sent my dad out to the parking lot and said, ‘Dad, I’ll meet you out there. I’m gonna go talk to this pretty girl.’

quotes.speaker: Shirley
quotes.text: So I was sitting at the bar by myself. Nobody approached me. Nobody said anything. My girlfriend was late. I waited.

quotes.speaker: Cris
quotes.text: Perfect. Basically… yeah. I chickened out.

quotes.speaker: Shirley
quotes.text: ‘Oh my God, I saw you today. I saw you today.’ And he starts describing what I was wearing and I’m, like, totally creeped out. Like—are you stalking me?

quotes.speaker: Shirley
quotes.text: The following Monday morning, I got roses sent to me at work.

quotes.speaker: Cris
quotes.text: A thousand weeks later, here we are, getting married. That’s the true story.
